notes: The Sufa's tail numbers (shared/aircraft/tail_number.gd, docs/aircraft-models.md §1.6): f16i.glb holds none (tools/f16/sufa.py).
notes.number: F-16I 846 of 201 Squadron, whose paint and fin art f16i.glb wears (docs/f16i.md §8.1)
notes.others: the other F-16Is in service in f-16.net's airframe database (docs/f16i.md §8, checked 19 Nov 2026), each squadron's in number order: 201 Squadron's (the player's), then Ramon's other two, 253 and 119 Squadrons'; Commons photos show 844, 849, 851, 869, 871 and 882 in 201's, 415, 466 and 476 in 253's, 469 and 494 in 119's. Not listed: written off or stored (107, 119, 480, 489, 493, 868) and the test centre's 401
notes.bases: the Sufas parked at Hatzerim: 107 Squadron's, the base's own (f-16.net; 803, 827 and 896 in Commons photos); the flying jets take them too after the list above, as the type's other real numbers
notes.marks: the fin's number in black, digits 0.37 m tall, foot level with the fin's leading-edge root; the intakes' in dark blue, 0.2 m tall, reaching out no farther than 0.7 m, short of the chin pylon and its pod (docs/f16i.md §8.1, measured on 846's photos)
